method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Microsoft stock jumps 4% as cloud growth drives earnings and revenue beat
Equities.summary: Microsoft reported better-than-expected results driven by 48% growth in Azure revenue.
Equities.reason: Large-cap Microsoft beat driven by strong Azure growth reinforces the AI-led tech leadership narrative and supports broader equity risk appetite — materially market-moving for megacap-weighted indices.

Equities.title: Alphabet sinks 10% as it holds 2026 capex unchanged, expects significant increase in 2027
Equities.summary: Alphabet missed Q3 expectations on earnings and revenue, its first top-and-bottom-line miss in nearly four years.
Equities.reason: A big miss and a 10% stock drop from a hyperscaler (plus capex uncertainty) is a major negative shock for the AI trade and tech-heavy indices — raises risk-off pressure across growth names.

Equities.title: Nasdaq-100 futures fall over 1% as Alphabet shares sell off after earnings report
Equities.reason: Immediate market reaction: >1% drop in Nasdaq futures signals near-term risk-off concentrated in mega-cap tech, likely to drag tech indices and sentiment intraday.

Equities.title: Equities: AI trade holds gains after hyperscaler earnings – Danske Bank
Equities.summary: Danske Bank strategists note that Equities advanced on Wednesday, with the S&P 500 and Stoxx 600 higher as the AI trade rebounded for a third session. Alphabet and Microsoft’s after-hours results delivered a mixed picture for AI-related revenues and capex.
Equities.reason: Captures the prevailing nuance: despite mixed hyperscaler prints, AI-led flows remain supportive and the trade has not collapsed — implies positive-but-fragile risk sentiment.

Equities.title: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all end higher after Fed leaves interest rates unchanged
Equities.reason: Fed holding rates unchanged is broadly supportive for equities via unchanged liquidity/discount-rate backdrop — provides a macro tailwind offsetting some tech-specific worries.

Equities.title: US tech stocks set to fall after earnings fuel AI spending concerns
Equities.summary: Nasdaq 100 to open 1% down after Google parent Alphabet and Microsoft report lower than expected capex
Equities.reason: Analyst/press take highlighting AI capex uncertainty and its negative effect on tech multiple — reinforces a cautious bias for the sector and supports the Nasdaq pullback narrative.

Equities.title: Oracle eases AI spending worries with plan to turn cash flow positive
Equities.reason: Oracle's guidance and clarity on financing helps calm AI spending fears, providing a selective positive signal for enterprise software and some AI-related names — partial stabilizer for equities.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: Official FOMC statement is the primary rates catalyst — Fed held rates and signalled an uncertain path amid sticky inflation, reinforcing a higher-for-longer yield regime (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Fed holds fire on interest rates despite intensifying inflation
Rates.summary: Central bank to vote on monetary policy seven times next year in shift from decades-old custom of having eight such meetings
Rates.reason: FT highlights persistent inflation and Fed reluctance to ease — strengthens market view of further hikes or longer restrictive policy, pressuring bond prices (negative).

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield creeps higher even as Fed keeps rates the same
Rates.summary: Treasury yields edged higher as traders await the Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy decision.
Rates.reason: Direct market reaction: rising 10-year yields despite Fed pause — evidence of stickier rates expectations and bond selloff (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Global Bond Sales Shatter Record, Fueled by AI Borrowing Binge
Rates.reason: Surging bond issuance increases supply pressure on markets; higher supply amid sticky policy expectations is a negative for bond prices / supportive of higher yields.

Rates.title: Basis trade retreat spurs shift into new rate bets
Rates.reason: Changes in basis trades and positioning imply shifting rate bets and potential volatility; suggests markets are repricing duration risk (net negative for bonds as positioning reduces demand).

Rates.title: Hong Kong Monetary Authority leaves interest rates unchanged, tracking Fed move
Rates.reason: HKMA following Fed maintains policy alignment — limits local easing prospects and supports higher-for-longer yield interpretation in regional fixed income (mildly negative).

FX.title: Euro remains under pressure ahead of ECB rate decision
FX.summary: EUR/USD depreciates after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 1.1140 during Asian hours on Thursday. The pair loses ground as the US Dollar (USD) bounces back from the previous day's losses after the Federal Reserve (Fed) kept interest
FX.reason: EUR weakness vs USD ahead of an ECB decision and USD bounce from Fed backdrop — clear USD-positive / EUR-negative driver with market attention on ECB policy.

FX.title: Japanese Yen declines due to stronger US Dollar, safe-haven outflows
FX.summary: USD/JPY recovers its recent losses from the previous day, trading around 158.00 during Asian hours on Thursday. The pair gains ground as the US Dollar (USD) bounces back from its previous day's losses.
FX.reason: USD rebound driving JPY weakness; USD/JPY sensitive to Fed and global risk flows — meaningful for front-end FX moves and JPY funding dynamics.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Holds gains above 102.00, bullish bias remains intact
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 102.25 in the early European trading hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: DXY holding >102 indicates broad USD strength — central, high-relevance theme that amplifies pressure on EUR/GBP/JPY/AUD and EMFX.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar strengthens as BoC delivers rate hike, US PCE data in focus
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair loses ground to near 1.3975 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. The Canadian Dollar (CAD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) after the Bank of Canada (BoC) delivers a rate hike.
FX.reason: BoC hike lifts CAD vs USD — a domestic-rate-driven currency move with direct transmission into USD/CAD and cross-asset yield differentials.

FX.title: Swiss Franc remains calm as US Dollar steadies on Fed outlook uncertainty
FX.summary: USD/CHF holds gains after paring daily gains, trading around 0.8280 during Asian hours on Thursday. The US Dollar (USD) lost recent gains after the Federal Reserve (Fed) kept interest rates unchanged as widely expected, while providing limited clarity on its n
FX.reason: CHF shows limited moves as USD steadies post-Fed — low-volatility, central-bank-driven nuance rather than a directional regime shift.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah gains ground due to possible BI intervention
FX.summary: USD/IDR continues to depreciate after pulling back from a nearly 5-month high of 18,223, reached on October 27, trading around 18,127 during Asian hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: Reports of Bank Indonesia intervention are a clear FX flow / policy signal for IDR stability — high relevance for EMFX and risk-sensitive positioning.

FX.title: HK Dollar Peg Architect Says Narrower Band May Ease Speculation
FX.reason: Discussion of narrowing the HKD peg band signals potential policy regime change / intervention mechanics — material for FX stability and regional capital flows.

FX.title: Indian Rupee falls further as higher oil prices continue to weigh
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) revisits a two-week low against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday as elevated oil prices continue to keep the South Asian currency under pressure. In the opening session, the USD/INR pair trades slightly higher to near 95.30.
FX.reason: Commodity-driven INR weakness (higher oil) increases USD/INR — a common EM pressure point with trade/payment-flow implications.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Tests consolidation breakout near 0.7040
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is down 0.14% to near 0.7040 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.
FX.reason: Short-term technical/price-forecast note showing modest AUD weakness vs USD — limited relevance beyond near-term price action.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bears await 1.1115-1.1110 support break as focus remains on ECB
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair meets with fresh supply during the Asian session on Thursday, stalling the previous day's modest recovery from the 1.1110 area, or its lowest level since May 2025 amid the emergence of some US Dollar (USD) buying.
FX.reason: Technical-focused EUR/USD bear-watch note — relevant for near-term levels but limited structural signal versus central-bank and DXY themes.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar remains depressed as USD bulls look to crucial data amid Fed hike bets
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair attracts some sellers following a modest Asian session uptick to the 0.5635-0.5640 region on Thursday, stalling the previous day's bounce from a two-week low, touched after the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) policy update.
FX.reason: USD bullishness tied to Fed hike expectations is pressuring NZD — a clear cross-market transmission (rates -> FX) with moderate relevance.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Weakens below 1.3350, maintains downside bias below 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades in negative territory around 1.3320 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The British Pound (GBP) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) following the UK Budget.
FX.reason: GBP under pressure vs USD after UK Budget and technical bias — relevant to G10 flows but more of a regional/technical theme.

Commodities.title: Gold slips as markets assess Fed signals, await US inflation data
Commodities.reason: Gold sensitive to US rates and Fed messaging; article frames gold weakness as driven by hawkish Fed signals and anticipation of US inflation data. This is a broad, market-level monetary driver for bullion, hence materially negative for gold prices.

Commodities.title: Gold sticks to bearish bias as USD stays firm amid Fed hike bets, ahead of US data
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers slightly from the daily low, though it retains an intraday bearish tone below $4,050 through the early part of Thursday’s European session.
Commodities.reason: Confirms intraday bearish bias driven by USD strength and Fed hike expectations — a dominant macro-flow for gold. Technical/intraday tone lowers relevance versus macro Reuters piece but still negative for bullion.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $53.50 amid Fed outlook uncertainty
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around $53.30 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Silver moving lower alongside gold as Fed/outlook uncertainty and USD strength weigh. This is a price-forecast/technical-style piece (lower relevance cap) but still contributes to a bearish precious-metals narrative.

Commodities.title: WTI climbs above $101.00 on Middle East supply risks
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), the US crude oil benchmark, is trading around $101.20 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. WTI rises amid renewed concerns about additional energy supply disruptions in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: Clear supply-risk driven rally narrative: Middle East disruption fears are a high-impact supply shock for crude, supporting prices above $100. High relevance due to direct supply-risk transmission to WTI.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Potential Gulf Coast production shut-ins are a tangible near-term supply disruption to US energy production (oil/gas). That supports higher oil and regional gas prices; relevance moderate given geographic scope but direct supply impact.

Commodities.title: Oil is Gushing Out of the Gulf. Why Are Prices Still Above $100 a Barrel?
Commodities.reason: Analytical piece noting that despite high physical flows, price remains elevated — implies persistent risk premium / tight market psychology. Supportive for the broader oil-price regime but less directly actionable than live supply-shock headlines.

Commodities.title: Oil Declines as Traders Parse Signs of Fresh Diplomacy on Iran
Commodities.reason: Reports that diplomacy reduces perceived Middle East risk, which is a deflationary signal for oil risk premium. Acts as a meaningful counter-signal to supply-risk headlines; relevance moderate given potential to relieve upside pressure.

Crypto.title: Security failure at Indian certificate firm bites Ethereum as developers rush out fixes
Crypto.reason: Client/certificate vulnerability raises short-term protocol security risk for Ethereum node operators and staking rewards — negative for network trust and price sensitivity around ETH infrastructure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as Samsung-led tech jitters and a hawkish Fed weigh on crypto
Crypto.reason: Macro and tech risk-off (hawkish Fed, sector jitters) draining risk appetite and pressuring BTC — reinforces sensitivity of crypto to rates and risk-on flows.

Crypto.title: Coinbase earnings: Wall Street divided on trading rebound after Robinhood crypto revenue sinks 55%
Crypto.reason: Exchange/trading volumes appear uneven; weaker retail trading revenue signals lower fee income and reduced market liquidity for crypto assets.

Crypto.title: Wall Street backbone DTCC brings $30 trillion securities closer to blockchain with major banks
Crypto.reason: Major institutional infrastructure (DTCC) moving toward blockchain integration is a strong positive for institutional adoption and long-term demand for tokenization and custody services.

Crypto.title: Google to preview crypto custody security system as AI threats grow
Crypto.reason: Big-tech investment in custody/security addresses a primary institutional barrier to crypto adoption; net positive for on‑ramp reliability despite AI threat backdrop.

Crypto.title: Securitize adds Stellar blockchain as institutional tokenization gathers steam
Crypto.reason: Expansion of tokenization platforms to Stellar signals growing institutional product breadth — positive for tokenized asset use cases and flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin treasury Datavault AI plunges 50% after firm says it can’t access its BTC
Crypto.reason: Custody/access failure at a treasury firm is a high-impact negative for confidence in institutional custody and could amplify outflows and selling pressure in BTC.

Crypto.title: AI found a way to crash bitcoin nodes on Windows and Macs. It's now public
Crypto.reason: Publicized vulnerability enabling node crashes increases short-term technical risk for Bitcoin network operators and may weigh on sentiment toward BTC reliability.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin-backed mortgages are coming to Canada, but borrowers are still unaware of the cost
Crypto.reason: Integration of BTC into mortgage products signals deeper financialization and retail/institutional linkage — mildly positive for long-term adoption but introduces credit/risk complexities.

Crypto.title: CFTC chief poses questions about policing AI but calls it a road to 'autonomous trading'
Crypto.reason: Regulatory engagement on AI in markets signals oversight but also tacit acceptance of algorithmic/automated trading evolution — modestly positive for institutional market structure clarity.

Crypto.title: XRP Ledger developers propose creating wallets with zero XRP for stablecoin payments
Crypto.reason: Technical change to lower friction for stablecoin payments on XRP Ledger increases utility and potential on‑chain flows — positive for that ecosystem's adoption.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $81,000 as Asian chip rally spills into crypto, pepe jumps 9%
Crypto.reason: Short-term risk-on spill from equities/tech lifts BTC and altcoins — reflects continued correlation with equity risk appetite and sector rallies.

Crypto.title: Nearly 90% of large businesses are embracing tokenized cash to speed up payments: DBS
Crypto.reason: Widespread corporate adoption of tokenized cash is a material demand-side signal for blockchain payments infrastructure and custody/settlement services.

Crypto.title: Brazil’s largest lender becomes first bank to formalize crypto brokerage under new rules
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity and formalization by a major Latin American bank signals regional institutional adoption and could unlock local flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: Bithumb hacked through employee system as South Korean financial firms face cyberattacks
Crypto.reason: Exchange compromise via employee systems highlights persistent operational/cyber risk to centralized venues — negative for exchange trust and short-term sentiment.
